prose: Vibe Rant regular favorites Michelle Lundquist and Mario Garza return! This power couple combine holistic wisdom with Michelle's Healing Home with mythological analysis on Symbolic Studies, and in this episode, our friends are here to discuss the human health ouroboros, the waters of our life. Is Shivambu legit? Proverbs 5:15: "Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well."
